answers.core: It's useful for web game-like dynamic download and load PCKs. This easy to build your own hot update/ Incremental update system.
answers.workaround: The EditorExportPlugin does not hook the _save_pack_file  process, not hook the _export_find_dependencies. It can't skip files to add in PCK by Skip().  I only can control the export_file to skip whole PCK file export.
